(2) LIMIT ENTRY MARKETABLE — instant fill → open/hard, sl_order_id+3 tp_order_ids all live in openAlgoOrders, anchor_shift≈0, TPs above/SL below fill; close_position leaves account clean. ONE REAL BUG: soft-watcher TP3 full close uses stale qty_remaining snapshot when multiple TPs are hit in the same pass.

minor.issue: Stale qty_remaining within one watcher pass: when TP2+TP3 are hit simultaneously (gap move), the final full close in _close_soft_trade reuses the pass-start trade snapshot. Reproduced: qty 3, TP1 closed 1.0 (pass 1), pass 2 closes TP2 partial 1.0 then TP3 'full' close with qty=2.0 instead of the actual remaining 1.0. Exchange-side is safe on Binance because close_position overrides qty from live positionRisk, but soft_realized_pnl/pnl_usdt accounting is computed with the stale qty → realized PnL overstated (got 20.0, expected 15.0 in repro). Reference: /app/backend/asi_bot/scheduler.py:77-130 (_close_soft_trade) called from :181-201 with stale `t`.

Engine rejects only notional < $5, but Binance testnet enforces min notional $20 (error -4164). Orders $5-$20 pass the precheck and fail at placement as entry_rejected. Cosmetic on Binance path (error surfaces cleanly), but precheck constant should track exchange MIN_NOTIONAL filter.

Failing test TestSoftWatcherSplit::test_tp_split_then_full_close documents expected behavior.

rca_of_issue: BUG RCA (soft watcher stale qty): _watch_soft_brackets iterates TPs using the trade document fetched once at pass start. Each _close_soft_trade call re-derives qty_remaining from that same stale dict. When TP2 (partial, 1.0) and TP3 (full) trigger in one pass, the TP3 full close computes qty from qty_remaining=2.0 (start-of-pass) instead of 1.0 (post-TP2). Reproduction: seed soft trade qty=3 TPs=[100,110,120], mark=105 → pass; mark=125 → pass; observe full close qty=2.0, pnl_usdt=20.0 (should be qty=1.0, pnl=15.0). Mitigation: exchange-side safe on Binance (close_position overrides with live positionRisk) so no over-close in production; only DB PnL accounting is wrong. Fix: refresh trade doc per TP iteration or thread updated qty_remaining through the loop.
